rationale.campaign_length: 51个直接任务跨越Y26与R86，直到安抚全部大精怪并控制多个大区。
rationale.colonization: 殖民不是主要循环，绝大多数目标位于既有国家和省份。
rationale.complexity: 任务、事件、决议、宗教路线、大精怪请求和形成国条件高度嵌套。
rationale.dark_story: 温暖狐灵外观最终转为阶级屠杀、政治清洗、强制改宗和灭绝性终局。
rationale.difficulty: 难点来自长链前置、裂界管理、大精怪要求和大范围征服，而非单一战役。
rationale.diplomacy: 姐妹关系、精怪交涉和部分任务要求外交准备，但国家后期更多依靠强制统一。
rationale.early_pressure: 开局周边扩张和区域强权带来压力，但经济与魔法底盘并非绝望。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 狐仙复活、裂界、密契、大精怪任务和精怪军队构成整场战役的核心。
rationale.narrative_density: 荷丽身份、仕女会夺权、狐仙重组、裂界、神婚和革命清洗形成连续长篇。
rationale.tall_play: 温泉、米酒、千座神社、首都与朝圣经济提供鲜明建设阶段，但最终仍服务扩张。
rationale.trade_economy: 朝圣、温泉和米酒带来经济经营主题，但没有独立贸易体系。
rationale.warfare: 地区统一、对命令秩序和霞国作战以及后期跨大陆征服贯穿全程。

identity.appearance: 1444年起始共和国；完成圣狐大婚后形成R86灵域并延续同一任务树

successors.relationship: 专属形成国；交换理念与任务后，以曾为Y26和狐仙解锁条件继续同一任务树

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 隐泉的密林幽谷间，温泉星罗棋布，暖雾氤氲。来自烟州乃至远方的旅人络绎于此——东洲大地之上，从耕夫到贵胄的疲惫人们，皆愿沉浸在这片疗愈汤泉中，让温润之水涤尽尘劳。
description.text_en: Throughout the woods and hills of Yinquan are countless warm and soothing hot springs which draw visitors from across Yanshen and beyond, as the aching folk of Haless, from peasants to nobles, come to relax in their healing waters.

description.text: 我们的国家由迷失而贫困的农民建立，他们离开自己的茅屋，寻找一个更好的家。当他们进入雾林时，他们被引导着穿过森林，并在狐狸精的指引下，在特定区域挖掘，最终发现了我们所熟知的温泉。从那时起，狐狸精保护隐泉不受暗影的影响，她们聚集在泉水和供奉它们的神龛周围，我们许多人养狐狸作为宠物，以向我们的欺诈师守护者们致敬。
description.text_en: Our nation was founded by lost and destitute peasants who had left their hovels to find a better home. When they entered the Mulim, they were guided through its woods, and directed by the fox spirits known as Huli Jing to dig in specific areas, ultimately revealing the hot springs for which our land is widely known. Since then, the Huli Jing have protected Yinquan from the shadows, gathering around springs and shrines devoted to them, and many of our people keep foxes as pets out of respect for our trickster guardians.

description.text: 雾林的浓雾使军队困惑了千百万年，甚至以魔法手段限制了航行。我们的人民已经被森林所拥抱，很快就学会了如何轻松地穿越雾林，有些人甚至学会了如何在行军时收集和利用雾来保护我们的士兵。
description.text_en: The thick and confusing mists of the Mulim have confounded armies for eons, even restricting navigation by magical means. Our people have been embraced by the woods though, and quickly learned how to traverse the Mulim with ease. Some have even learned how to gather and harness the mists to shield our soldiers when on the march.

description.text: 黎禾是最具影响力的狐狸精，在早期指导我们的国家，据说她现在仍然生活在我们中间，领导着我们。黎禾仕女是她最亲密和最虔诚的追随者，在隐泉进行仪式和表演，并努力维护遍布在雾林的无数神龛。
description.text_en: Liho was the most influential of the Huli Jing in guiding our nation in its early years, and it is said that she continues to live among us, leading us even now. Liho's Maidens are her closest and most devout followers, performing rituals and performances across Yinquan and diligently maintaining the countless shrines dotted throughout the Mulim.

description.text: 诃利秣早在踏入烟州之前就已听闻隐泉温泉的盛名，而当他终于抵达这片土地时，便探访了其中最为宏伟的一处泉眼，流连忘返之至，竟留下一支亲兵卫队常年驻守，只为保其永世安宁，以待他日再临。千载之后，似日春风，凤皇贾赫亲临此泉，为这片被誉为「征服者之泉」的土地，更添不朽传奇。
description.text_en: Harimar had heard of the springs of Yinquan long before he ever even entered Yanshen, and when he reached us he visited the largest of them all, enjoying himself to such an extent that he left a garrison of his warriors to defend it to ensure he could visit in perpetuity. More than a thousand years later, the same spring would be visited by the Phoenix Emperor himself, Jaher, and the prestige of the area, now known as Conqueror's Spring, increased even further.

description.text: 众者皆知，隐泉之水，涤尽倦意，更润心防——邻国官吏浸浴时常吐露平日缄口之事。而我们自有耳目，愿将诸般讯息呈于领袖案前。
description.text_en: The waters of Yinquan are known to loosen more than tired muscles - officials from neighboring lands tend to speak far more openly in our baths than they would normally, and we have eyes and ears willing to pass information along to our leaders.

description.text: 当烟州大地在军阀与征服者的铁蹄下燃烧，隐泉始终是和平与安宁的净土。即便交战国的商旅亦能在此卸下戒备，宁和地进行贸易。这片宁静滋养着我们，从四方来客中觅得丰饶商机。
description.text_en: While Yanshen burns under the heels of warlords and conquerors, Yinquan has always been a land of peace and tranquility, where merchants of even warring nations can relax and trade in peace. We benefit from this serene atmosphere, finding lucrative trade opportunities from our visitors.

description.text: 这一称号起初用来称呼雾林——据说那儿的神社数量甚至超过了林子的树木，但现在「万龛之地」的美誉则属于灵域。在崇尚灵魂的当局鼓励之下，诸多神社、圣坛、灵龛在东洲各地如雨后春笋般涌现。而致力于服务诸灵（但最重要的当然是狐狸精）的密契则在东洲掀起了皈依的狂潮——仿佛人们等候已久，此时终于可以宣布自己真正的信仰为何！
description.text_en: While initially a title dedicated to the Mulim forest, where it is said that shrines outnumber the trees, Lingyuk has earned the epithet "Land of Ten-Thousand Shrines". Encouraged by the spirit-revering government, shrines of countless kinds have popped up across Haless. Dedicated to all manner of spirits big and small (especially the Huli-Jing), the Mystic Accord has rocketed upwards in popularity - almost as if the people of Haless were waiting for the moment to proclaim their true faith!

name.text_en: The Land of Ten Thousand Shrines

description.text: 东洲诸灵是我们的保护者和指导者，但最受尊崇的莫过于狐仙本身。祂原已是隐泉的领袖，最终肩负起团结灵魂种群的天命，没有比祂更适合引导整个灵域的人选了！重铸形体的狐仙是名副其实的无尽魔力之源；与烟河之神结缘赐予了祂不可思议的强权伟力。狐仙对使用魔法兴趣不大——毕竟，祂不需要以此带领国家走向伟大。然而，当狐仙真的开始唤起魔力之时，即使是山脉也会屈从于灵域的旨意。
description.text_en: All spirits are revered as protectors and mentors, but none more so than Huszien Herself. Already the leader of Yinquan, the realm which finally took up the mantle of uniting spirit-kind, She was a natural candidate to lead all of Lingyuk. Her reconstructed form is a veritable wellspring of magic; wed to Yanhe, She has at Her disposal an almost inconceivable amount of power. Huszien is loath to use it. After all, She does not need magic to steer the nation to greatness. When She does use it, however, even the mountains bend to the decrees of Lingyuk.

description.text: 狐仙统治着国家，但祂纷繁的思绪化为的无数灵魂则统治着狐仙本身。狐狸精和九尾狐，狐仙这一存在的化身与面相，时常会晤并讨论如何妥当地处理狐仙周遭的世界。这就是所谓的「无尽思辨」。在辩论中占主导地位的一方将会影响狐仙的主体人格，可以按照自己的意愿建议祂的行事方式。这种独特的安排为狐仙和统治阶层带来了不少关于如何达成共识的重要教训。我们要善用这些经验，在不损害灵域团结的情况下更为妥善地安抚少数群体。
description.text_en: Huszien might rule the nation, but Her composite spirits rule Her. The Huli-Jing and the Gumiho, the aspects of Her existence, regularly gather together to debate how best to process the world around Huszien. This is known as the Endless Debate. Whoever is dominant in these debates influences Huszien's personality, advising Her to act one way or another even as she comes to her own conclusions. A unique arrangement like this has given Huszien and the ruling class a number of very important lessons on how to reach a consensus. Using those lessons, more minority groups can be placated without compromising the unity of Lingyuk.

description.text:
千年以来，东洲被迫远离其自然的状态。上庙，出自令人厌恶的先驱精灵之手，几乎将灵魂们驱逐出了整座大洲。我们与灵界的手足兄弟分离得如此之久，几乎忘记了这片土地的真容。

再无此事！灵域，灵魂统治的霸权，将铲除一切存在腐朽；我们向东洲之上的所有虚伪「国家」发动战争。他们的分歧将被鲜血冲刷干净，大陆将重归并永归它应有的原貌：人类和灵魂，和谐共存直至永恒。
description.text_en:
Haless has been forced away from its natural state for millennia. The High Temples, constructed by some loathsome batch of precursors, all but banished spiritkind from the continent. Separated from our brethren for so long, we have all but forgotten the truth of this land.

Nevermore! Lingyuk, the spirit domain, shall excise the rot that has set in; we declare war against all the false "nations" of Haless. Once their divisions have been washed away with blood, the continent shall return to the state it should have always been in: Man and spirit, co-existing in eternal harmony.

description.text: 黎禾仕女是一个可以追溯到数世纪前的古老组织。它最初由隐泉赞助，之后发展到涵盖整个灵域。它的成员习得了一种风格独特的魔法：大量使用仪式化的舞蹈，以及如今极为著名的「御币」长杖。她们的法术有助于纯化军队使用的兵刃，确保它们始终精准无误。与此同时，士兵身披的盔甲在浸润了狐仙的力量之后，足以抵御更为猛烈的破坏性打击。
description.text_en: The Maidens of Liho are an organization that dates back centuries. First patronized by Yinquan, they have since grown to encompass the entirety of Lingyuk's state. They practice a unique style of magic that makes heavy use of ritualized dances and the now well-known gohei staff. This magic serves to purify our weapons, ensuring that they always strike true. Our armor, meanwhile, seems all the more willing to suffer otherwise destructive blows after being imbued with Huszien's power.

description.text: 烟河魂，伟大之龙，在灵域崇奉的体系之中仅次于狐仙。身为狐仙的夫君，烟河魂有责任视狐仙的子嗣为己出，得到精心的照料。事实上，震龙帝也绝非斤斤计较这点小事的心胸狭隘之辈：奔涌的烟河对灵域的子民们而言是慷慨而善意的母亲河，它丰沛的水量携带着大量富含营养的泥沙，足以使两侧河岸与以此浇灌的土壤肥沃欲滴。国内的农民只需要每日例行公事的耕作，就足以丰收连年——这一切都要归功于我们与灵魂的和谐相处。
description.text_en: Second only to Huszien is Yanhe, the Great Dragon. As he is the husband of Huszien, it is his duty to ensure that Her children are as well cared for as his. In this regard, Yanhe is generous; The Yanhe river is always welcome and friendly to the children of Lingyuk. Its waters are especially fertile, quick to rejuvenate the soil along its bank. Our farmers are able to produce great harvests with no extra effort - all through our harmony with the spirits.

description.text: 在狐狸精们的大力推崇之下，原本就具有悠久历史的隐泉节日已被证明极具感染力。诸多古老的节庆活动开始风靡整个灵域，最终被编纂为一本统一的节日历。在频繁而欢乐的庆祝活动期间，人类和灵魂携手共庆，丝毫不在乎对方的身份。正是如此，灵域的和谐才得以充分展现。这一切的欢乐也带来了更加快乐的民众。
description.text_en: Yinquan's rich history of festivals, encouraged by the Huli-Jing, has proven contagious. Many of their holidays and celebrations have spread throughout Lingyuk, leading ultimately to the creation of a single, unified calendar. These celebrations are incredibly frequent, and during them men and spirit mix without any care for the identity of others. It is here that the harmony of Lingyuk can be seen in full display. All of the merriment has led to a much happier populace, too.

player_overview.avoid_if: 如果你只想玩轻松可爱的狐狸国家，或讨厌任务等待、指定省份条件、复杂前置和不可回避的政治清洗，请避开。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 前期统一烟申北部并建设温泉朝圣经济，中期围绕荷丽、狐仙和裂界完成复杂事件链，后期形成灵域、安抚全部大精怪并向烟申、拉罕和维姆达隆持续扩张。
player_overview.overview: 隐泉前半段是温泉、米酒、神社、狐灵与女法师荷丽的民俗奇幻：收复故土、调查高殿、拼回狐仙并主动引爆裂界。形成灵域后，玩法转为安抚大精怪、征服东洲和仕女会革命；土地改革与人灵共存理想，很快和屠杀商人、清洗军官官僚、强制归顺及灭绝反抗者结合。它极其独特，也刻意让可爱开局滑向黑暗神权。
player_overview.recommended_for: 适合喜欢狐灵民俗、超长连续剧情、魔法和精怪机制、国家形态突变以及后期大征服的玩家。
signature_features: 通过高殿调查和狐灵碎片复活狐仙，主动提前引爆裂界并转入密契路线。
完成大精怪要求、安抚灵性存在并解锁精怪军队，把世界事件变成国家主线。
从Y26隐泉形成R86灵域后继续同一任务树，经历土地革命、阶级清洗和跨大陆人灵统一。
player_overview.tagline: 从温泉狐灵共和国走向灵界降临，以仕女神权和大精怪之力把整个东洲改造成一座残酷乌托邦。

reasons: 可爱民俗开局与黑暗神权终局形成极强反差
狐仙复活和主动引爆裂界把世界级机制直接纳入国家叙事
大精怪安抚、精怪军队与神婚提供少见的灵性玩法
Y26到R86的51任务连续战役具有明确阶段和超长后期目标
warnings: 部分大精怪请求不能预览，并可能要求等待或临时占领特定省份
后期需要跨多个大区持续征服，管理量和战役长度都很高

values.rationale: 前期以精怪保护、人灵共存、民俗建设和公共改革为主；形成灵域后权力高度集中，并出现政治清洗、强制统一和针对拒绝新秩序群体的极端暴力，因此用激进化轨迹而非静态邪恶标签。
red_flags: 针对拒绝新秩序群体的极端暴力
